rules.statement: Where the intended fraud is not accomplished, the maxim 'in part delicto potior est conditio defendantis' has no application, and the party who has delivered the property may lawfully reclaim it before the alleged purpose is carried out.
rules.supporting_quote: "The law is that where the intended fraud is not accomplished, the maxim in part delicto potior est conditio defendants has no application, and the party who has delivered the property may lawfully reclaim it before the alleged purpose is carried out. See Mohamadu Marikar v. Ibrahim Naina"
